# fp1-bpm-fast

**Origin:** authored for this repository, generated byte for byte by a
script and checked in as bytes. Not a third-party work.
**Licence:** MIT, as with the rest of the repository.

## Why it is here

fp1-bpm-slow with only the #BPM and #BPM01 values changed. Positions are
measure-relative, so a tempo edit moves no onset.

One half of a pair with `fp1-bpm-slow`. Each chart is asserted against its
own value; the pair exists so that an implementation which tells the two
apart fails on at least one of them.

An fp1 fixture, chosen for what it exercises in the algorithm rather than as
music. It is not a template for a good chart.
